name: matlab-simulate-radar-detections
description: Configure, simulate, debug, and analyze radarDataGenerator within radarScenario. Use for: interactively building radar detection scenarios from datasheets or performance requirements; diagnosing missed detections and configuration errors; interpreting sensor spherical, body, and scenario-frame outputs; deriving ReferenceRange from hardware specs via link budget; scan mode configuration (mechanical, electronic/AESA, hybrid); and validating simulation results against analytical predictions.
